title: D3 residence visa for teaching, highly qualified or cultural activity

sources.title: Lei n.º 23/2007 (foreigners law), articles 58.º, n.º 5, and 99.º, n.os 1 and 4: the family members who may apply with the principal, and the other parent's consent for a child of only one spouse
Lei n.º 23/2007, article 99.º, n.º 6: the marriage or de facto union must be valid and recognized under Portuguese law, and both spouses or partners 18 or over on the date of the application

Lei n.º 23/2007, article 100.º, n.º 1: reunification may be authorized with the partner in a duly proven de facto union and the partner's unmarried minor or incapable children entrusted to the partner
Lei n.º 23/2007, article 52.º, n.º 1, a) and b): no visa during an entry ban that follows a removal, or under a Schengen Information System alert for return with an entry and stay ban

Decreto-Lei n.º 41/2023, article 28.º, rewording article 52.º, n.º 1, c), of Lei n.º 23/2007: no visa under an alert for refusal of entry and stay in Portugal's border system (SII UCFE), or for return
Lei n.º 23/2007, article 52.º, n.º 3: a residence visa is refused after a conviction for a crime Portugal punishes with more than one year of prison, even if not served or suspended
Lei n.º 23/2007, article 58.º, n.º 2: a residence visa is valid for two entries and lets its holder stay for four months
Lei n.º 23/2007, article 58.º, n.º 4: the residence visa application is decided within 60 days
Lei n.º 23/2007, article 75.º, n.º 1: a temporary residence permit is valid for two years from the issue of the card and renewable for successive periods of three years
Lei n.º 23/2007, article 209.º, n.º 1: the fees for visas granted by consular posts are those of the table of consular fees
Lei n.º 23/2007, article 4.º: the law covers foreigners and stateless persons, not nationals of EU or EEA states or of a state with an EU free movement agreement
Portaria n.º 1563/2007, article 2.º, n.º 2: means per household member against the minimum wage net of social security: first adult 100%, other adults 50%, under 18 and dependent adult children 30%
Decreto-Lei n.º 139/2025: guaranteed minimum monthly wage of EUR 920 from 2026-01-01
Código dos Regimes Contributivos (Lei n.º 110/2009), article 53.º: the worker pays 11% of pay in social security contributions, so the net minimum wage is 89% of it
Decreto Regulamentar n.º 84/2007, article 24.º-B, n.º 2: the family members who may accompany a residence visa applicant are those of articles 99.º, n.º 1, and 100.º, n.º 1, of Lei n.º 23/2007
Decreto Regulamentar n.º 84/2007, article 24.º-B, n.º 1, b): proof of stable and regular resources for the applicant and the accompanying family, set by article 2.º, n.º 2, of Portaria n.º 1563/2007
Lei n.º 7/2001, articles 1.º, n.º 2, and 2.º, a): a de facto union is two people living as spouses do for more than two years; it grounds no right while either is under 18 when it is recognized
Portaria n.º 91/2025/1, article 2.º: EUR 110 for processing a national visa application (article 15.º, n.º 4, of the table of consular fees), in force from 2025-03-11
Portaria n.º 229/2021 (table of consular fees), article 22.º, n.º 1: children up to the age of 6 pay no visa fee, and those from 6 and under 18 may be exempted
Decreto Regulamentar n.º 1/2024, rewording article 10.º, n.º 1, of Decreto Regulamentar n.º 84/2007: a visa application is made on its own form, on paper or electronic
Decreto Regulamentar n.º 84/2007, article 10.º, n.º 3: the visa application of a minor or an incapable person is signed by the legal representative
Decreto Regulamentar n.º 1/2024, rewording article 12.º, n.º 1, a) and c), of Decreto Regulamentar n.º 84/2007: photographs or a digital facial image, and the criminal record certificate
Decreto Regulamentar n.º 84/2007, article 12.º, n.º 1, b), e) and f), and n.os 5 to 7: travel document, insurance, means, authorization for a minor, insurance exemption, no criminal record under 16
Decreto Regulamentar n.º 84/2007, article 4.º: to enter and leave Portugal, a travel document is valid at least three months beyond the planned stay
Decreto Regulamentar n.º 1/2024, rewording article 24.º-B, n.º 1, a), of Decreto Regulamentar n.º 84/2007: a family member's visa application comes with proof of the family ties
Lei n.º 23/2007, article 72.º, n.º 1, c): the stay of a residence visa holder may be extended by up to 90 days
Lei n.º 23/2007, article 52.º, n.º 4: a visa is refused to a danger or threat to public order, security, national defence or public health
Lei n.º 61/2025, adding article 52.º, n.º 10, to Lei n.º 23/2007: a residence visa is refused after an illegal entry or stay in Portugal where article 144.º, n.º 1, applies
Lei n.º 23/2007, article 61.º, n.º 1: residence visa for teaching, highly qualified or cultural activity, with a contract, an invitation letter or a certified company's statement of responsibility
Decreto-Lei n.º 41/2023, rewording Lei n.º 23/2007, article 61.º, n.º 1, c): the statement of responsibility of a company certified as a portaria of the migration and economy ministers defines
Lei n.º 23/2007, article 61.º, n.º 3: a visa under article 61.º is decided within 30 days
Lei n.º 23/2007, article 3.º, n.º 1, a): a highly qualified activity is one that needs specialized technical skills of an exceptional nature or a suitable qualification
Lei n.º 23/2007, article 61.º-A, n.º 1, a), as Lei n.º 53/2023 worded it: a contract or promise of at least six months paying 1.5 times the average gross annual wage or three times the IAS
Lei n.º 23/2007, article 61.º-A, n.º 1, b) and c), and n.º 2: high professional qualifications, and the lower pay threshold for listed shortage professions
Decreto Regulamentar n.º 84/2007, articles 32.º and 32.º-A: the application carries the documents that prove the conditions of articles 61.º or 61.º-A of the law
Portaria n.º 328/2018 (Tech Visa), as republished by Portaria n.º 59-A/2022: the worker's conditions (article 5.º) and the statement of responsibility (article 7.º)
Portaria n.º 1563/2007, article 5.º, n.os 1 and 3: 12 months of means for research, higher-education teaching or highly qualified work, less or none if the host guarantees them; else the visa stay

requirements.title: Not a citizen of an EU or EEA state or of Switzerland, Portugal included: the foreigners law, and so this visa, does not apply to them

assessments.title: One of: a work contract or its promise, or a services contract; an invitation from a teaching or training body, a research centre or a body with a recognized cultural activity; a Tech Visa statement
The activity is teaching at a teaching or vocational training institution, cultural, or highly qualified, which needs specialized technical skills of an exceptional nature or a suitable qualification
Employee path: a contract or promise of 6 months or more paying yearly at least 1.5 times the average gross annual wage or 3 times the IAS; 1.2 or 2 times for CITP 1-2 jobs a resolution lists
Highly qualified employee path: high professional qualifications, recognized as the law requires for a regulated profession, or suited to the activity or sector of the contract for another
Tech Visa path: 18 or older, no permanent residence in the EU, taxes and social security in order where applicable, no criminal record, Portuguese, English, French or Spanish suited to the job
Tech Visa path: ISCED 2011 level 6 or higher, or a level 5 higher technical course with 5 years of exceptional skills; a work or services contract of 12 months or more paying 2.5 times the IAS a year
Means a month of the 2026 minimum wage net of 11% social security (EUR 818.80, from EUR 920) for the principal, plus 50% of it per other adult, 30% per minor and per dependent adult child
Means assured for at least 12 months for highly qualified work or higher-education teaching, less or none if the host guarantees them; for other work, the visa stay with its extension
Each applicant: no entry ban in force after a removal from Portugal, and no alert for return or for refusal of entry and stay in the Schengen Information System or in Portugal's border system
Each applicant: no conviction for a crime that Portugal punishes with more than one year of prison, even if the sentence was not served or was suspended
Each applicant: no danger to public order, security, national defence or public health, and no illegal entry or stay in Portugal that bars a residence visa under article 144.º, n.º 1

dependents.title: Spouse; possible if either spouse is under 18: reunification depends on both being 18 or over and on a marriage valid and recognized under Portuguese law, which is not checked and may reach this visa
Children under 18, taken to be in the couple's charge; an adoption must be recognized by Portugal and a child of only one spouse needs the other parent's consent or a custody decision: not checked
The spouse's children under 18, taken to be in the couple's charge; an adoption must be recognized by Portugal and the other parent must consent or a custody decision must exist: not checked
Adult children who depend on the principal, only if incapable, or single and studying at a school in Portugal, which is not recorded: possible
The spouse's adult children who depend on the principal or the spouse, only if incapable, or single and studying at a school in Portugal, which is not recorded: possible
Parents who depend on the principal
The spouse's parents who depend on the principal or the spouse
Partner in a de facto union of more than two years, both aged 18 or over; counts only if the union is duly proven and recognized under Portuguese law, which is not recorded: possible
The partner's unmarried children, under 18 or incapable, legally entrusted to the partner, when the union of more than two years counts; none of this is recorded: possible

costs.title: Consular fee for processing the residence visa application of a principal aged 18 or over
Consular fee for processing the residence visa application of a principal aged 6 to 17, which the consulate may waive
Consular fee for the residence visa application of each accompanying family member aged 18 or over
Consular fee for the residence visa application of each child aged 6 to 17, which the consulate may waive; children under 6 pay nothing

durations.title: Decision on the residence visa application within 30 days under the teaching, highly qualified or cultural article; within the general 60 days for the employee path
Residence visa: two entries and a stay of four months in Portugal, to apply there for the residence permit
First temporary residence permit, counted from the issue of the card; then renewable for successive periods of three years

documents.title: Visa application on its own form, on paper or electronic; for a minor or an incapable person, signed by the legal representative
Two identical passport-type colour photographs with a plain background, current and showing the applicant clearly, or a facial image captured digitally, as the case may be
Passport or other valid travel document
documents.note: To enter Portugal it must be valid at least three months beyond the planned stay

documents.title: Criminal record certificate from the competent authority of the country of nationality or of the country where the applicant has lived for more than a year; not asked under 16
Valid travel insurance covering the medical expenses needed, including urgent medical care and possible repatriation
documents.note: An applicant who proves it cannot be obtained may be exempted

documents.title: For a minor under 18 subject to parental responsibilities, or an adult under a protective measure (maior acompanhado), the authorization for the application
Proof of means of subsistence, as the means portaria defines them for the type of visa applied for
Employment contract or promise of one, or services contract
Invitation letter from a teaching or vocational training institution, a research centre, or an entity with a cultural activity of recognized interest
Statement of responsibility from a company certified under the Tech Visa programme
Highly qualified employee: proof of high professional qualifications, recognized where the profession is regulated
